title: Sync artifact revision
instructions:
## Purpose
Review how an open Review UI responds to artifact changes while retaining the last valid artifact and isolating comments by revision.

## Regeneration
Inspect src/server/review-updates.ts, src/server/read-artifact.ts, src/server/create-artifact-revision-id.ts, src/client/data-client.ts, and src/client/pages/workspace-page.tsx. Check the revision-update scenarios in specs/user-continue-new-review.spec.tsx and the server and workspace revision tests. Reconstruct the product flow from change detection through validation, branching into retaining the current artifact or activating and displaying the new revision.

nodes.title: Artifact change detected
nodes.description: File polling and SSE notify the open workspace of artifact changes.

nodes.title: Is the changed artifact valid?
nodes.description: The server validates the new artifact's JSON, schemas, and diagram composition.

nodes.title: Keep the last valid artifact
nodes.description: When the change is invalid, show the error and keep the current artifact.

nodes.title: Activate the new revision
nodes.description: Compute the revision ID of the whole valid artifact and replace the current review.

nodes.title: Show the updated artifact
nodes.description: Show the new diagrams and exclude comments from the previous revision from the current canvas.
